messages:
maya: FYI after last-night's IdP cert rotation we started getting session bounces for EU users and some SCIM role updates disappeared. Anyone else seeing odd behavior?

sam: yup, reproduced locally. SAML flow returns success but session cookie is immediately cleared. Happens on Chrome & FF. :confused:

jen: SCIM shows 200 for PATCHs, but downstream audit log missing role-change events. Looks like we accepted payload but role write failed.

maya: @sam can you paste SP logs. @aaron did the KMS rekey run late last night? wondering if decrypts failed when writing server blobs.

sam: log snippet: 
[sp] 2026-03-22T02:13:45Z Received SAMLResponse size=5.8kb
[sp] 2026-03-22T02:13:45Z Assertion signature verified cert-thumb=ab:cd:ef:33
[sp] 2026-03-22T02:13:45Z Created session id=sess_9f8a cookie set
[sp] 2026-03-22T02:13:45Z Session validate: KMS decrypt failed rpc DEADLINE_EXCEEDED
[sp] 2026-03-22T02:13:45Z Cleared session id=sess_9f8a

jen: that KMS timeout explains SCIM ack behavior. Our provisioning path decrypts extId before role mapping; on decrypt timeout we currently ack to avoid duplicate retries, which silently drops role writes.

aaron: I promoted a rekey at 02:11 UTC. Control plane reported success. KMS p95 spiked ~3.4s between 02:11-02:14, matching the window.

sam: I can reproduce by adding a 3s sleep to KMS decrypt — creates session then we immediately invalidate. Workaround idea: fallback to cached decrypted extid when KMS times out, but that risks using stale key if rekey actually rotated the envelope.

jen: For SCIM I propose changing ack semantics: if decrypt fails return 409 once so IdP can retry, otherwise ack. That surfaces backpressure instead of silent loss.

aaron: I'll implement cached-decrypt fallback with a strict TTL (24h) and a metric tag when used. If no cache, return 409. Will open PR and canary to eu-prod first.

maya: I'll add an audit preflight entry before write: "role write attempt (pending)" and update to success/failure so we never lose trace of attempted changes.

sam: also add prometheus counter scim_role_write_failures_kms_timeout and sp_session_kms_timeouts. Postmortem should recommend coordination window for rekeys.

jen: noted. Also include vuln-triage note: swallowing KMS timeouts is a data-loss risk. Postmortem should define a platform pattern: either explicit retry-with-backoff or fail-fast to surface to IdP.

aaron: agreed. I'll coordinate infra to pick quieter rotation window and add a short jitter to rekey time to avoid overlapping active decrypt storms.

oncall-bot: incident created INC-2026-031-07: "IdP cert rotation overlapped KMS rekey causing decrypt timeouts -> session invalidation & SCIM role drops".

maya: thanks. Action owners: aaron (cached-decrypt + ack-change), jen (audit preflight + metrics), sam (repro & canary), maya (postmortem + timeline & KMS graphs).

jen: I'll draft recommended code pattern for handling KMS-decrypt errors. Short, explicit retries then surface to caller if persistent.

sam: good plan. tagging this in the incident ticket. :thumbsup:
